name: Domain-based Octree with Range Bounding Boxes
definition: An acceleration structure using an octree over the domain to store interval ranges (RBBs) at each node, allowing filtering of tetrahedra that cannot intersect a given FSCP edge by comparing the edge against the node's RBB.
summary: This octree acceleration structure efficiently identifies tetrahedra intersecting fiber surface edges by storing range bounding boxes, distinguishing itself through strict domain-based partitioning.
